description: Run a Google search and get structured organic results (title, URL, snippet, position) as JSON. Costs 1 SERP credit per successful search. Use for rank tracking, competitor research, or finding sources on a topic. Pagination: start must be a multiple of 10 (0 = first page).

domain.description: Google domain to search on. Default "google.com".

num.description: Number of results to return (10-100). Default 10.

start.description: Result offset for pagination — must be a multiple of 10. Default 0.

name: google_serp
